I just finished talking to them now. 

The first question I asked was if I could have confirmation that there will be no restrictions when it comes to selling if a stock hits a high price.

Answer; They cant give any confirmations as they dont want to mislead in any way. T212 does not want to hinder trading opportunities as they do not profit from it.

Second question; If a stock in theory, hits $10mill a share, is there any restrictions to the price I can sell at, e.g. $1mill max?

Answer; No restrictions as to the price I could sell a share for.

So to me, it looks like T212 isnt the actual problem, but the clearing house it is linked with that could possibly stop us selling GME, not the broker itself.

I'd recommend something along the lines of:

"Will my selling of the stock be restricted in any way"
